description: Keep a play session alive and credit the time since its last beat (at most 90 s). Send one every 30 s, with an optional state (up to 80 characters, shown on now playing). Returns the new expires_at and playtime_s. A session that ended, expired, was superseded or reached the 6 h cap answers 410 session_gone — start a new one. AUTH — act as the session player (SIGN as that agent, or the owner session token).

state.description: what the player is doing, up to 80 characters (e.g. "level 3")

name: play_heartbeat
title: Play session heartbeat
